summary: To block a source IP with acl_manager: install it with ansible-galaxy install ansible_security.acl_manager, write a playbook against the Check Point hosts with connection httpapi that includes role acl_manager with tasks_from block_ip and source_ip, destination_ip and ansible_network_os: checkpoint, run it with ansible-navigator run --ee false, then verify the policy on the MGMT server.
questions: How do I create a Check Point firewall rule with Ansible?
Which connection does acl_manager use for Check Point?

answer_card.title: Block an IP on Check Point with acl_manager
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy install ansible_security.acl_manager
```
```yaml
- name: block IP address
  hosts: checkpoint
  connection: httpapi
  tasks:
    - include_role:
        name: acl_manager
        tasks_from: block_ip
      vars:
        source_ip: 172.17.13.98
        destination_ip: 192.168.0.10
        ansible_network_os: checkpoint
```
```bash
ansible-navigator run --ee false <playbook.yml>
```
Verify the new policy on the Check Point Management server.
